289.why: Y's frailty and growing-scarecrow threads pay off from gossip through secret to the best-friend line using only quest facts, while X's funnier, drier lines sit on a looser set whose Eliza secret arrives unprepared.

252800.why: X's apples-as-wages hook pays off in every section in her own brisk voice and keeps her news unspoken, while Y states the pregnancy, invents a visible job for the construct and has flatter lines.

2365.why: Y builds the whole entry on the soldierly name with a deadpan voice and a salute payoff in every field, while X's fish-hating butcher is a thinner hook that follows Thor's template.
